messages:
incidents-bot: Paging: p99 latency breach on streaming.generate.v1 in canary pool — threshold 900ms, observed ~2.1s sustained for last 3m. Alert: INCIDENT-1749200000 :rotating_light:

morgan.eng: seeing it on dashboard too. canary group A (20% traffic) spikes. p95 also creeping up to ~700ms.

tara-oncall: i'm taking this. oncall stack: i'll grab traces and check rollout logs. tagging @liam-platform for rollout history. :wave:

liam-platform: thanks. we pushed model v4-quant-canary@09:12 UTC to group A, gradual ramp from 5% -> 20% over 8m. no config changes besides quant profile.

morgan.eng: quick look at prometheus — CPU/GPU util fine, but KV cache miss rate jumped from 2% -> 18% for the canary hosts. tail latencies align with cache miss bursts.

sre-janet: curious if tokenizer change in v4 touched prefix layout causing cache churn. pulling model diff now.

ryan-op: i'm running a fast histogram dump from the serving runtime to surface per-shard p99. attaching snippet:

```
# tail latency histogram canary-host-7
p50  42ms
p90 210ms
p95 420ms
p99 2140ms
qmax 3800ms
```

morgan.eng: that qmax is consistent with user reports of streaming stalls. any backlog in the muxer?

liam-platform: rollback window still open. if we abort canary v4 rollout, traffic can be shifted back to v3.1 within 2min. canary control plane shows no capacity shortage.

tara-oncall: prioritize live mitigation: 1) throttle canary ingress to 5% 2) disable KV prefetch for v4 instances 3) prepare rollback if tail > 1.5s after throttling. executing step 1 now.

incidents-bot: Action: throttled canary group A to 5% (triggered by tara-oncall). Notification logged.

morgan.eng: after throttle, p95 dropped to ~360ms within 45s. p99 down to ~880ms but occasional spikes remain ~1.6s. cache miss rate falling.

customer-success-alex: any customer visible impact? cs reports a small number of timed-out streaming sessions from two enterprise tenants between 09:18-09:21. opened support cases.

sre-janet: model diff shows tokenizer table reorder; kv key calculation unchanged but prefix lengths increased on some inputs — likely increased KV entries creating more evictions.

liam-platform: ok canary rollback plan ready. if we still see frequent >1.2s spikes in next 3m, we should roll v4 back from canary. rollback command (dry-run):

```
redwoodctl rollout cancel --target canary/A --version v3.1 --force
```

ryan-op: also suggest warming cache for v4 instances with representative prompts if we keep them. that might reduce miss tail while we evaluate. warming job queued.

tara-oncall: warming started. monitoring. p99 now ~760ms and frequency of >1.2s spikes dropped to ~2/min (was ~8/min). good sign but still above SLO for some windows.

morgan.eng: i'll run an eval run on a retained trace set against v4 quant to see quality delta vs v3.1 while we stabilize.

incidents-bot: Incident note added: initial mitigation (throttle -> warm) reduced incident severity from P1->P2.

customer-success-alex: flagged affected customers, offered telemetry + SLA credit preemptively. keeping them in the loop.

liam-platform: metrics look stable for now but let's keep canary at 5% for 30m and collect full perf/kv telemetry. if any recurrence, immediate rollback.

ryan-op: leaving the warming job active for 10m then evaluate. I'll also add temporary eviction leniency on canary hosts to reduce churn.

tara-oncall: handoff to next oncall in 20m. i'll prepare a succinct handoff note: root cause suspected tokenizer change increasing KV cardinality for certain prefix patterns; mitigation = throttle + warm + eviction leniency; rollback available.

morgan.eng: noted. logs and traces attached to the incident ticket (INC-1749200000). leaving a short checklist for postmortem: reproduce with synthetic prefix floods, validate tokenizer fix or KV key normalization, add canary perf gate for KV miss delta >5%.

sre-janet: agree on perf gate. also add a short preflight to measure KV growth on model diff in staging.

liam-platform: i'll schedule a rollback runbook review and add an automated canary throttle step to future rollouts if KV miss delta exceeds threshold.

tara-oncall: i'm signing off this thread for now — next oncall is @sre-janet. will DM with detailed notes. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Incident status: monitoring -> mitigated (P2). follow-up: postmortem requested, assignee: morgan.eng.
